cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Quality Engineer with automotive product quality experience to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Identify, develop, and support continuous improvement of quality processes and projects that increase value through improving performance, product and process quality, safety, and cost. Facilitate problem solving team activities from root cause identification to implementation of permanent corrective actions. Ensure product and process quality through effective planning, tracking, analyzing, reporting, and problem solving. Write quality procedures and administer documentation systems. Develop and perform internal process and product audits. Maintain statistics about vendor quality, in-process quality, and finished product quality. Knowledge of 6-Sigma / Lean Manufacturing methodologies. Proficient in quality management systems (ISO 9001, TS16949, etc.). Will develop Process Flows, PFMEAs, and Control Plans.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor of Science in Engineering or equivalent degree
2-5 Years' experience in the Quality Engineering field or equivalent
Familiarity with automotive quality requirements
Experience with electronic data collection and analysis using SPC / capability software (Minitab, MeasurLink, etc.)
Ethical, quality-oriented individual capable of managing multiple projects in a team environment
Preferred Requirements:
CQE, CQA or CRE (ASQ) certification
Motivated self-starter with the desire for continuous improvement
Will consider non-degreed candidates with great experience.
